notes: The check creates a temporary source tree and verifies real JSON path/line/submatch data, gitignore/hidden filtering, explicit overrides, PCRE2 lookbehind and exit codes 0/1/2.
Exit 0 means a match; exit 1 means no match; exit 2 means an error. A no-match result is not an installation failure.
Default searches skip hidden, ignored and binary files. Use explicit flags appropriate for the research task; the framework does not choose a data visibility policy.
RIPGREP_CONFIG_PATH can alter user commands. The qualification disables external configuration and global/parent ignore rules so its fixture has explicit search boundaries.
The payload-free wrapper delegates install/removal to APT. Wrapper integrity, original Debian-byte integrity, package metadata and actual function checks are separate evidence.
Private extracted-package qualification does not imply an APT transaction or OCI qualification.
usage.summary: Search compiler source and experiment artifacts recursively with fast regex, structured JSON matches and explicit ignore-file control.
